verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs describe official Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers that connect applications to BigQuery so you can use it with your preferred tooling, which covers the standard-driver path for dashboards. A hands-on community report on the BigQuery–Sheets connector found it works, with only a minor cell-type quirk (formulas come back as text). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of named BI-tool integrations (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI dashboard connectors), and independent hands-on corroboration of the JDBC/ODBC drivers feeding dashboards.
